insights.title: Fairness
insights.subtitle: Who gets to play, whose training load is changing, and how well the pitch is used. All of it comes from records you already keep.

error.title: Could not load this view
error.body: Check your connection and try again. Nothing was changed.

played.label: Players with match minutes
played.hint: Counted from finished stints on the pitch

evenness.label: How evenly match minutes were shared
evenness.hint: Gini coefficient {{value}}, where 0 is perfectly even
evenness.hintNone: No finished match minutes to compare

noSquad.title: No players yet
noSquad.body: Add your squad first. Everything here is built from the players you list.

noEvidence.title: Nothing recorded yet
noEvidence.body: Minutes come from matches you record, and attempts from sessions where you note what you saw. Once there is something, it appears here.

fair.openStints_one: {{count}} stint is still open (a player was never taken off), so it is not counted in the minutes.
fair.openStints_few: {{count}} stints are still open (a player was never taken off), so they are not counted in the minutes.
fair.openStints_other: {{count}} stints are still open (a player was never taken off), so they are not counted in the minutes.
fair.missingMinutes_one: {{count}} attendance mark has no minutes recorded, so it is left out of training minutes.
fair.missingMinutes_few: {{count}} attendance marks have no minutes recorded, so they are left out of training minutes.
fair.missingMinutes_other: {{count}} attendance marks have no minutes recorded, so they are left out of training minutes.

second.title: Second look
second.note: This is a list of who has not had a fair look yet. It is not a ranking.
second.none: Everyone has at least {{min}} attempts observed.

ledger.title: The ledger
ledger.caption: Match minutes, training minutes and what was observed, for each player
ledger.noAdjusted: Nothing observed in the squad yet
ledger.barLabelNoRange: Adjusted rate {{point}}, no range can be drawn
ledger.shrinkage: Small samples are pulled towards the squad average, because two from two is a player we have barely watched, not a 100% player.
ledger.barKey: The bar is the range ({{level}}%) the true rate is likely to sit in, and the mark is the adjusted rate: a wide bar means little has been observed. Players with fewer than {{min}} attempts are in the second look. Rates pool every skill recorded, so they describe what was observed, not how good a player is.

age.title: Relative age
age.intro: Children born early in the year are older than their year-group peers, and that can quietly shape who is picked and who plays.

needsMore.title: Add birth quarters to see this
needsMore.body: This check needs the birth quarter of at least {{needed}} players, and {{known}} have one so far. Only the quarter is stored, never a birth date.

age.minutesChart: Share of match minutes by birth quarter
age.noMinutes: No match minutes yet, so there is nothing to compare by quarter.
age.legend: Q1 is January to March, Q2 April to June, Q3 July to September, Q4 October to December. Dashed marks show the share an even spread across the year would give.
age.basis: Based on {{known}} players with a birth quarter.
age.unknown_one: {{count}} player without one is left out.
age.unknown_few: {{count}} players without one are left out.
age.unknown_other: {{count}} players without one are left out.
age.caveat: With 14 to 20 players this check has low power: it can only see a large imbalance. So “consistent with an even spread” means this squad cannot tell, not that selection is fair.
age.details: January to March share {{q1}}, against {{expected}} for an even spread. Probability that the true share is above even: {{probability}}.
age.pSkipped: Exact test not run: the squad is too large for it.

too_few.title: Too few players
too_few.body: Fewer than 8 players have a birth quarter, so nothing is said.

consistent_with_even.title: Consistent with an even spread
consistent_with_even.body: Nothing here stands out from an even spread of birth dates across the year.

leans_older.title: Leans towards older players
leans_older.body: More players were born in January to March than an even spread would give, which means a lean towards the oldest children in the year group. Treat it as a reason to look, not a finding.

strongly_older.title: Strongly towards older players
strongly_older.body: Clearly more players were born in January to March than an even spread would give. It is worth checking how minutes and selection are decided.

load.callout: Load is minutes times how hard the player said it was. It shows change, not risk. It cannot predict injury.
load.caption: Training load this week, compared with each player's recent weeks

no_data.label: No data this week
no_data.explain: Nothing recorded for this player this week.

incomplete.label: Ratings incomplete
incomplete.explain: Too many of this week's minutes have no effort rating, so no comparison is made.

no_baseline.label: Not enough history
no_baseline.explain: Not enough earlier weeks recorded to compare with yet.

steady.label: Steady
steady.explain: In line with their recent weeks.

sharp_increase.label: Sharp increase
sharp_increase.explain: Well above their recent weeks: worth a conversation with the player.

load.matchNote: Match minutes are shown for context only. No effort rating is collected for matches, so they are not part of the load.
load.chartNote: Adds up minutes times effort rating for sessions that have a rating, so a week with missing ratings looks lower than it was. The last bar is this week so far.
load.chartItem: week of {{week}}: {{load}}, players with a session: {{players}}

empty.title: No training load recorded yet
empty.body: Load needs who was present, for how long, and how hard it felt to them. Mark attendance with effort ratings after a session.

load.missingMinutes_one: {{count}} attendance mark has no minutes recorded, so it is left out of the load.
load.missingMinutes_few: {{count}} attendance marks have no minutes recorded, so they are left out of the load.
load.missingMinutes_other: {{count}} attendance marks have no minutes recorded, so they are left out of the load.

perHour.label: Players per pitch-hour
perHour.hint: Children attending, for each hour of a full pitch

floodlit.label: Floodlit hours
floodlit.hint: Hours of sessions held under the lights

estimates.title: Estimates

emissions.label: Emissions
emissions.hint: Energy times your grid emissions factor

estimates.prompt: Some estimates need numbers from your club settings: floodlight power, electricity price or the grid emissions factor.
estimates.note: These are estimates from the numbers you typed in, not meter readings. Floodlights are assumed to light the whole pitch whatever share was booked.

right.title: Right-sizing
right.intro: Sessions that booked more pitch than the number of children needed, with the smaller area that would have fitted. This is a prompt about booking habits, not a verdict on any session. It assumes about 22 players fit comfortably on a full pitch.
right.caption: Sessions that booked more pitch than needed
right.total: In total, {{hours}} pitch-hours could have been freed.

none.title: No over-booked sessions
none.body: Every completed session booked about as much pitch as the children needed.

empty.title: No completed sessions to look at yet
empty.body: Pitch use is worked out from completed sessions with attendance marked.

pitch.withoutAttendance_one: {{count}} completed session has no attendance recorded and is left out of these figures.
pitch.withoutAttendance_few: {{count}} completed sessions have no attendance recorded and are left out of these figures.
pitch.withoutAttendance_other: {{count}} completed sessions have no attendance recorded and are left out of these figures.
